name: Yorba Linda Library Teen Advisory Board (TAB)
what_you_do: Give the library ideas on teen books, activities and programs. You work on a creative team and build leadership skills. Your hours can count for school service rules.
who_can_apply: Teens 13 to 18 who live in Yorba Linda now. You need past leadership experience and an email you check at least twice a week.
pay_detail: Volunteer. Hours may count toward school service rules.
deadline_text: The last round opened March 28, 2026 and closed May 16, 2026 at 4:59 p.m. Interviews were in June. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Get the form on the program page when the next round opens. Turn it in at the Adult Information desk. Late forms are not taken. Questions: libraryteens@yorbalindaca.gov.
notes: These are last year's dates. The 2027 dates are not posted yet. Members who are 18 or older must be fingerprinted. The program page does not list meeting dates.
